::::: {.blog-docs}

## Build once, then publish

Changes pushed to `main` (or a manual workflow dispatch) launch the [Quarto Publish workflow](https://github.com/YONGHUNI/blog/blob/main/.github/workflows/publish.yml). It checks the renderer, builds the site once, and deploys the already-rendered result.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The production workflow, including its homepage file check."
flowchart TD
    A["Push main / manual dispatch"] --> B["Checkout + install Nix"]
    B --> C["Python unittest<br/>dependency metadata"]
    C --> D["scripts/render-site.py<br/>one Pixi environment"]
    D --> E["One Quarto HTML render<br/>_site + _freeze"]
    E --> F["Check _site/index.html<br/>exists and is not empty"]
    F --> G["Clear disposable .quarto cache"]
    G --> H["Set up matching<br/>Quarto 1.9.37"]
    H --> I["Publish to gh-pages<br/>render: false"]
    I --> J{"Auto-freeze outputs<br/>changed?"}
    J -->|Yes| K["Commit freeze + manifest<br/>to main / skip ci"]
    J -->|No| L["Finish without commit"]
```

## The lifecycle as a sequence

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The publishing process separates the source branch, render output, and public website."
sequenceDiagram
    actor Editor
    participant Main as main branch
    participant Runner as GitHub Actions
    participant Branch as gh-pages branch
    participant Browser as Visitor browser
    Editor->>Main: Push change
    Main->>Runner: Run publishing workflow
    Runner->>Runner: Nix + tests + Pixi + Quarto
    Runner->>Branch: Publish existing _site (no rerender)
    Branch-->>Browser: Serve HTML and assets
    opt Auto-generated cache has changed
      Runner->>Main: Commit saved results [skip ci]
    end
```

## Workflow settings

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Trigger and concurrency

```yaml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: quarto-gh-pages-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false
```

The workflow is restricted to `main`; non-main pushes do not deploy through it.

### Build command

```bash
nix develop -c python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py' -v
nix develop -c python scripts/render-site.py
```

The renderer creates one shared `pixi exec` runtime and calls Quarto once for the whole site. The Nix tool versions are pinned; the runtime package versions are not fully locked.

### Publishing without rerendering

```yaml
- name: Publish pre-rendered site
  uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/publish@v2
  with:
    target: gh-pages
    render: false
```

The publishing step uses Quarto `1.9.37`, matching the version used for rendering. CI removes the disposable `.quarto/` project cache between those phases to avoid incompatible internal state; `_site/` and `_freeze/` are retained.

### Automatic freeze commit

```text
On successful publish:
  stage scripts/freeze-manifest.json
  stage additions / modifications / deletions in _freeze
  unstage all manually frozen post subtrees
  if staged diff exists:
      commit "[BOT] Update automatic Quarto freeze [skip ci]"
      push to main
```

GitHub Pages serves the rendered HTML and assets as a static website.

:::

## Local verification and failure diagnosis

These commands use the current `x86_64-linux` Nix development shell.

```bash
# Report dependency selection without executing:
nix develop -c python scripts/render-site.py --dry-run

# Run metadata tests:
nix develop -c python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py' -v

# Run the complete site build:
nix develop -c python scripts/render-site.py
```

The production workflow runs the Python tests and checks that `_site/index.html` exists and is not empty. It does not validate every HTML file, link, or rendered layout.

If a build fails, check the unit tests, conflicting `ci-packages`, missing explicit freeze files, and Quarto errors. If rendering succeeds but publishing fails, inspect the publishing step and its branch permissions.

**See:** [CI source](https://github.com/YONGHUNI/blog/blob/main/.github/workflows/publish.yml) · [Recent GitHub Actions runs](https://github.com/YONGHUNI/blog/actions)
